article.description: — Connor McDavid had a goal and an assist to give him nine points through three games as the Edmonton Oilers beat the Seattle Kraken 3-1 on Saturday night.

article.story: EDMONTON, Alberta -- — Connor McDavid had a goal and an assist to give him nine points through three games as the Edmonton Oilers beat the Seattle Kraken 3-1 on Saturday night. Owen Michaels and Leon Draisaitl also scored for the Oilers (2-0-1). Devon Levi made 19 stops to earn the win in the Oilers’ net. Bobby McMann had the lone goal for the Kraken (1-1-0). Philipp Grubauer recorded 22 saves for Seattle. After McMann made it a 1-1 game 9:06 into the second period, it was Draisaitl who eventually broke the deadlock. Draisaitl scored with 2:27 left in regulation, with McDavid adding an empty-netter with 1:05 remaining. Edmonton has gone 15-4-1 against the Kraken, including winning eight of nine meetings at home. UP NEXT Kraken: Have their home-opener against the Calgary Flames on Sunday. Oilers: Head to Anaheim to play the Ducks in a first-round rematch on Wednesday. ------ See AP’s full NHL coverage here
